asserts.title: Palace Bookshelf
asserts.comment: C3 My Books reflects the borrow from fixture 05 — same book + author + Read/Remove actions persist after navigation back to root. Validates: TPPBookRegistry.shared kill (Phase 6.6) — registry write must reach My Books view via DI rather than singleton broadcast. If the registry write is mutated, this fixture shows an empty My Books OR the wrong book.

kills_mutants.rationale: list rendering — empty filter or wrong sort would show no books or different book
registry observation — broken subscription would leave stale empty state
the singleton kill itself — failure to deliver state through the new DI path lands here
